We also want w to happen before r') so an all-rf external cycle in which every thread orders its own R before its own W is a cycle in the model's OWN accept/propagate order -- NO pred term and NO read-removal step of 4.2 is consulted so the argument needs neither cumulativity nor multi-copy atomicity
